intro.title: Count characters as you type.
intro.say: Is your bio too long? Count the characters as you type.

scenes.say: Open three one five tools dot com, slash text. The character counter is the first tool.
Type or paste your text. The numbers update as you type.
scenes.sub:
Type or paste your text.
Numbers update live

actions.text: Coffee lover. Weekend hiker. Small shop owner in Blue Peak.
